title: Nigeria unifies FX windows
detail: The central bank merges its exchange-rate windows. The official rate jumps from about ₦461 to ₦750 per dollar within days.

title: ₦900 by year end
detail: A $50,000 order that cost about ₦23m in May now costs about ₦45m.

title: Second naira slide
detail: The naira falls past ₦1,400 per dollar as dollar shortages persist.
